convert_seqlogical_to_decoupled: convert a seqlogical form token list to the decoupled form using get_decoupled
convert_noisy_decoupled: convert a bracket form string to noisy decoupled form using get_noisy_decoupled
check_intent_token: check if a token is an intent token using DecoupledUtils.is_intent_token
check_slot_token: check if a token is a slot token using DecoupledUtils.is_slot_token
numberize_rows_with_decoupling: numberize data rows with optional source and target decoupling using DecoupledSeq2SeqData
